value.rationale: The eight-oscillator source reports 5 active dimensions and stability sampling but no internal topology. The new theorem locates two exact, distinct internal straight coupling lines at which the global shape-space invariants change from two components to one and then increase in genus, while oscillator count remains fixed. Connectedness and genus affect global families of phase-locked solutions; their complete parameter description is a naturally motivated exact invariant. The result is restricted to those solution sets; it does not claim new polygon homology methods, physical stability, or attractor bifurcations.
